headline: Result Update

highlights: Data centres are emerging as a key growth area, with the newly launched Grid-to-Rack offering providing an integrated portfolio of transformers, GIS, automation and substations.
Management also expects continued traction in services and exports, with service order intake growing 77% YoY and export order intake increasing 41% YoY in Q2FY27.

Ongoing capacity expansion across transformers, high-voltage equipment, automation and HVDC is expected to support future growth, with most projects targeted for completion by the end of next year and the large power transformer facility planned for 2028.
Management remains focused on profitable growth, execution, productivity and quality, while monitoring working capital requirements, West Asia-related uncertainty and elevated commodity prices.
valuation: Ongoing capacity expansion across transformers, high-voltage equipment, automation and HVDC is expected to support future growth, with most projects targeted for completion by the end of next year and the large power transformer facility planned for 2028.
We keep our BUY rating on the stock with a target price of ₹49,936, due to healthy order inflow and increasing opportunities in BESS and data centre segments.
